It does not verify a named customer/person, household, address, age, registration, ownership/security interest, selected coverage or right to payment. No scope extension of Helsehjelp, liability or legal assistance.

Separate insured events/owner capacity, third-party family exclusions and dispute requirements. A general person-scope detail cannot prove eligibility to these particular benefits or remove their conditions.
Insured objects and general policy authority respectively, neither retains who is insured and the six precise address/registered-rights conditions.

Contents insurance from another provider includes other fixed-household members and explicit tenancy exclusions, without the whole registered-property rights group. Different insured interest/type/scope; no approved synonym.

Travel/person-versus-family selection, age21, residence/social-insurance and named-person contexts differ; mortgage/security rights in insured real estate are absent. Do not import age/family/selection rules.
